raw_text: The Indian Army has detected fresh Chinese military buildup near the Galwan Valley sector of the Line of Actual Control ahead of the fourth anniversary of the deadly June 2020 clash, according to senior defense officials. Satellite imagery shows new construction of helipads and prefabricated shelters at forward positions in the Aksai Chin plateau. India has responded by deploying additional forces to its own positions along the LAC in eastern Ladakh. The buildup comes despite ongoing diplomatic talks between the two sides.
